blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Today's lesson is Simple Budget. Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. It is about clear, honest numbers.

You will learn five useful words: budget, cost, saving, limit, and plan. You will use them in short, natural sentences with the finance team. The budget always has to match the records.

Go slowly — one step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is today's lesson about?
items.why: "Today's lesson is Simple Budget."

items.q: How many useful words will you learn?
items.why: "You will learn five useful words."

items.q: According to the text, the budget always has to match the…
items.why: "The budget always has to match the records."

items.q: The text says "Go slowly — one step at a time." This suggests that…
options: learning calmly, step by step, is the good way
you do not need to learn the words
the lesson is easy if you rush
items.why: Inferência: o texto pede calma e um passo de cada vez — aprender devagar é o caminho certo.

items.q: The line "You can do it!" suggests that the author wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: o tom é de encorajamento — o autor quer que você se sinta confiante.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o tema para um novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the accounting team. My name is Sophie. I am happy to help you today.

Our team is small, but we are very organised. We work with numbers every day. The numbers must be clear and honest. That is our job.

Look at this. There is a new cost to review this week. It is not big, but we still check it. We have some savings this month, and that is good news.

We also have a limit. We check the limit at the end of every day. We do not spend a lot of money. We spend some, not too much. That is a simple budget.

Here is the plan for today. Please read it, and leave it on my desk when you are done. Take your time. One careful step at a time — that is how good accountants work. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking, and what is her job?
items.why: "My name is Sophie… Welcome to the accounting team."

items.q: How does Sophie describe the team?
items.why: "Our team is small, but we are very organised."

items.q: When does the team check the limit?
options: At the end of every day
At the start of the week
items.why: "We check the limit at the end of every day."

items.q: Sophie says "We spend some, not too much." This suggests the team is…
items.why: Inferência: gastar um pouco e não demais mostra que a equipe é cuidadosa com o dinheiro.

items.q: How does Sophie want the new trainee to feel?
items.why: Inferência: "Take your time… You can do it!" — ela encoraja o trainee a ficar calmo e confiante.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have a small budget this month." A budget is…
options: a plan for the money we can spend
items.why: Budget = orçamento: o plano de quanto dinheiro podemos gastar.

items.q: "There is a new cost to review this week." A cost is…
items.why: Cost = custo: o dinheiro que pagamos por algo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We have some ___ this month, so we spend less money."
items.why: Saving = economia: dinheiro que guardamos e não gastamos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We have a ___ , so we do not spend a lot of money."
items.why: Limit = limite: o máximo que podemos gastar.

items.q: "Please read the plan and leave it on my desk." A plan is…
options: a list of steps or ideas
items.why: Plan = plano: uma lista de passos ou ideias para o trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho com números. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the budget." To sign off on means to…
options: say yes to it and approve it
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o "ok" final.

items.q: "Let's go over the costs together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, olhar com cuidado.

items.q: "Can you write down the new cost?" To write down means to…
items.why: Write down = anotar, colocar no papel.

items.q: "The costs are going up, so we need to cut back." To cut back means to…
items.why: Cut back = cortar gastos, gastar menos.

items.q: "Please fill in the plan before lunch." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, completar com as informações.
